title: Courage Through God’s Presence
opening: Courage in Scripture does not mean we never feel afraid. It means we remember God’s presence and choose the faithful next step.
points: Meditate on Scripture so God’s truth shapes your response to fear.
Ask trusted people for counsel instead of facing every challenge alone.
Take the next right step with courage, humility, and care for others.
reflection: What is one wise and faithful step you can take today?
prayer: God, remind me that You are present. Give me courage to do what is right and wisdom to seek help when I need it. Amen.
